visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Merge in One Pass Instead of Concatenating and Sorting
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The two arrays are joined and sorted again, which ignores that both are already sorted. Merge them with two indexes. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Merging takes about n + m steps because it uses the existing order. Sorting the joined array takes (n + m) log (n + m) steps and throws that knowledge away.
